description: Na₂GdMnAs₂O₉ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two MnO₆ octahedra and corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 66-73°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.66 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two MnO₆ octahedra and corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 66-73°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.66 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.85 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.85 Å. There are two inequivalent Gd sites. In the first Gd site, Gd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.57 Å. In the second Gd site, Gd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.58 Å. There are four inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.16 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.15 Å. In the third Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 73°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.16 Å. In the fourth Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 73°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.15 Å. There are four inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MnO₆ octahedra and corners with three NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-68°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.75 Å. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-68°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.75 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MnO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-71°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.75 Å. In the fourth As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MnO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-71°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.75 Å. There are eighteen inequivalent O sites.
